title: RADIUS: Ranking, Distribution, and Significance - A Comprehensive Alignment Suite for Survey Simulation
abstract: arXiv:2603.19002v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Simulating survey responses with LLMs offers a scalable alternative to costly human data collection, yet evaluation methods remain ad hoc and inconsistent. Current metrics, typically borrowed from adjacent domains, focus on accuracy or distributional similarity while overlooking ranking alignment-whether simulations preserve the relative preference orderings observed in human populations. A simulator may achieve low distributional divergence yet fail to identify the option humans most prefer, a critical gap for decision-making applications. We propose RADIUS, a two-dimensional alignment suite that evaluates survey simulation along complementary axes: 1) RA alignment and 2) DIstribUtion alignment, accompanied by statistical Significance testing. translated_title: RADIUS：排序、分布与显著性——用于调查模拟的综合对齐评估套件
translated_abstract: 使用大语言模型（LLM）模拟问卷回复为成本高昂的人类数据收集提供了一种可扩展的替代方案，然而现有的评估方法仍然零散且不一致。当前的指标通常借鉴自相邻领域，侧重于准确性或分布相似性，却忽略了排序对齐——即模拟结果是否保留了在人类群体中观察到的相对偏好顺序。一个模拟器可能实现较低的分布差异，却未能识别出人类最偏好的选项，这对决策应用而言是一个关键缺陷。我们提出RADIUS，一个二维对齐评估套件，沿互补的两个维度评估调查模拟：1）排序（RAnking）对齐和2）分布（DIstribUtion）对齐，并辅以统计显著性（Significance）检验。在多个社会调查和角色来源上的实验表明，RADIUS揭示了单一指标评估的局限性，并提供了更强的区分能力。
tldr: 该论文提出RADIUS评估套件，从排序对齐、分布对齐和统计显著性三个互补维度全面评估基于LLM的调查模拟质量，弥补了现有单一指标忽视模拟是否保留人类相对偏好排序这一关键缺陷。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes RADIUS, a two-dimensional alignment suite that evaluates LLM-based survey simulation through ranking alignment, distribution alignment, and statistical significance testing, addressing the critical gap where existing single metrics overlook whether simulations preserve human preference orderings.
